chemistry-killer-10.title: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry
chemistry-killer-10.goal: Analyze the principles of Chemical Bonding and Molecular Geometry and deduce the correct conclusion under given conditions.
chemistry-killer-10.material:
Kuwani waa dheellitirka falgalka isku-dhejinta ammonia. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (falgal exothermic ah). Weel xidhan oo heerkul joogto ah, ka dib marka dheellitir la gaadho, shuruudaha hoos ku qoran si gooni gooni ah ayaa loo beddelay, waxaana la gaadhay dheellitir cusub.
(I) Heerkulka ilaali, mugga weelka yaree.
(II) Mugga ilaali, heerkulka kordhi.
(III) Heerkulka iyo mugga ilaali, Ar(g) aan falgalin ku dar.
(IV) Heerkulka iyo cadaadiska (guud) ilaali, Ar(g) ku dar si mugga loo kordhiyo.
(V) Heerkulka iyo mugga ilaali, $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ ku dar.
Waa kuwee kaliya kuwa ay tirada (mol) ee $\mathrm{NH_3}$ dheellitirka cusub kordho marka loo eego dheellitirkii hore?
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.prompt:
Kuwani waa dheellitirka falgalka isku-dhejinta ammonia. $\mathrm{N_2(g) + 3H_2(g) \rightleftharpoons 2NH_3(g)}$, $\Delta H < 0$ (falgal exothermic ah). Weel xidhan oo heerkul joogto ah, ka dib marka dheellitir la gaadho, shuruudaha hoos ku qoran si gooni gooni ah ayaa loo beddelay, waxaana la gaadhay dheellitir cusub.

(II) Mugga ilaali, heerkulka kordhi.
(III) Heerkulka iyo mugga ilaali, Ar(g) aan falgalin ku dar.
(IV) Heerkulka iyo cadaadiska (guud) ilaali, Ar(g) ku dar si mugga loo kordhiyo.
(V) Heerkulka iyo mugga ilaali, $\mathrm{H_2(g)}$ ku dar.
Waa kuwee kaliya kuwa ay tirada (mol) ee $\mathrm{NH_3}$ dheellitirka cusub kordho marka loo eego dheellitirkii hore?
chemistry-killer-10.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Mole-ka gaaska falgalaya waa walxaha falgala 4 mol → walxaha soo baxa 2 mol. Falgalka hore waa exothermic.
Tallaabo 2: (I) Mugga yaraaday = cadaadiska kordhay → wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa falgalka hore ee yareeya mole-ka gaaska → NH3 wuu kordhaa.
(II) Heerkulka kordhay → falgalka dambe ee endothermic → NH3 wuu yaraadaa.
(III) Mugga joogto, Ar lagu daray, xoogga (cadaadiska qayb-ahaaneed) ee N2, H2, NH3 ma beddelmo sidaa darteed Q = K wuu sii jiraa → dhaqdhaqaaq ma jiro, NH3 ma beddelmo.
(IV) Cadaadiska joogto, Ar lagu daray waxay kordhisaa mugga, xoogga gaasaska falgalaya dhammaantood wuu yaraadaa → wuxuu u dhaqaaqaa falgalka dambe ee kordhiya mole-ka gaaska → NH3 wuu yaraadaa.
(V) $\mathrm{H_2}$ lagu daray → Q < K → falgalka hore → H2 qayb ka mid ah ayaa la isticmaalaa NH3-na wuu kordhaa (tirada mol ee NH3 way kordhaa).
Tallaabo 3: Kuwa NH3 kordhaya: (I), (V).
Jawaab: (I), (V) (b).
